# stalwart_cluster_role (Data Source)

Defines a cluster node role with enabled tasks and listeners.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object. Set either `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) Unique identifier for the role

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the role
- `listeners` (Attributes) Which network listeners are enabled for this cluster role (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--listeners))
- `tasks` (Attributes) Which tasks are enabled for this cluster role (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tasks))

<a id="nestedatt--listeners"></a>
### Nested Schema for `listeners`

Read-Only:

- `listener_ids` (Set of String) List of network listeners to enable or disable for this group
- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.


<a id="nestedatt--tasks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tasks`

Read-Only:

- `task_types` (Set of String) Tasks to enable or disable for this group
- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.
